problem: Malformed raw JSON could be mislabeled as network failure.
fix: Strict codec translates JSON reader IO failures into invalid response; transport IO remains separate.

problem: Using the old immutable receipt/serverNow could enable a stale continuation.
fix: Refresh mode, eligibility/serverNow and matching current material before checking the strict boundary.

problem: Failed release-policy refresh discarded the previous force-upgrade display.
fix: Preserve previous policy rows as read-only alongside the explicit error.

problem: An intermediate verification compiled 38 scenarios while six more were added; its end-of-run hashes alone could not establish source stability.
fix: Runner now compares entry and exit source hashes; final run made with fixed source throughout.

problem: New synthetic TECHNICAL_PROCESSING fixture omitted required reviewCaseId/roundNo; strict codec correctly rejected it.
fix: Set the existing required case identity and round; retain the incomplete fixture as a required rejection.

problem: Constructed request schema failures escaped as exceptions before the HTTP error handler.
fix: Reject before network and map to explicit LOCAL_INVALID_REQUEST page error.

problem: Library default made the first test APK target API26 rather than the app target API35.
fix: Declare targetSdk35 alongside minSdk26 and compileSdk35 in the isolated module.
